subject: Re: Redwood pricing & startup discount — post-demo follow-up (DeepFin)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@scalewise.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pricing & startup discount — post-demo follow-up

Hi Samir — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Call highlights:
- DeepFin wants to embed real-time summarization + search reranking for analyst notes.
- Expected production traffic: ~40–60M tokens/month in month 1, ramping to ~150–200M tokens/month by Q3 if latency targets hold.
- Key constraints: strict data isolation, predictable unit economics for forecasting, and procurement-friendly contract terms.

Pricing & levers we discussed:
- Baseline hosted price (uncommitted): $1,800 / 1M tokens (generation + inference token mix estimated).
- Target unit economics you mentioned on-call: target $800–1,200 / 1M tokens with committed-use discounts and startup incentives.
- Committed-use options: 12-mo or 24-mo T&Cs available; discounts scale by commit size (examples in attached deck).
- Startup program: we can apply the startup program credit + an additional 20% committed-use discount for qualifying early-stage AI customers (see attached terms).

Next steps (proposed):
1) You: confirm expected month-1 and month-6 token run-rate and whether the security questionnaire needs to be routed now.
2) Us: send a formal quote showing (a) uncommitted hosted rate, (b) 12-mo committed tier for ~2.5B tokens/year, (c) startup program credit applied.
3) Loop in procurement/legal for standard SOW/DocuSign of committed-use MOU.

I've attached a short pricing deck and the startup program terms. Ben — looping you for pricing approval on the 20% extra startup incentive for this deal.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Attachment: Proposed_SLA_and_Pricing_Deck.pdf
From: Samir Patel <samir@scalewise.ai>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@deepfin.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing & startup discount — post-demo follow-up

Marissa — great recap, thanks. A few clarifying points from our side: 

1) Token run-rate: the 40–60M/month for month 1 is accurate for our initial pilot (ingest + summarize). We expect production to hit ~120M tokens/month by month 6, and ~180M by month 9 if accuracy/latency are as demoed.

2) Budget: procurement has $250k allocated initially for the pilot. We can consider a committed budget if we see predictable cost per 1M tokens in the $900–1,000 range.

3) Startup program: Scalewise is a Series A company (raised $6M). Is there a minimum ARR or traction threshold for your startup credits?

4) Procurement/legal ask: we prefer a 12-month committed-use PO with quarterly true-ups. Can you provide a sample MOU with the committed tier that maps to the 120M/month expected by month 6? Also need the SSO/KMS details for security review.

Thanks —
Samir
Head of Product
Scalewise (DeepFin pilot)
samir@scalewise.ai

Samir / Marissa — looping in Laura from our pricing ops to expedite the formal quote. Quick notes from pricing leadership: 

- Startup program eligibility: Series A with $6M raise qualifies for the standard startup credit (6 months of service credits + onboarding support). Details are in Redwood_Startup_Program_Terms.pdf attached. There is no strict minimum ARR but we ask for a short application and a COO/CFO confirmation.

- For committed-use pricing to hit your target of ~$900–1,000 / 1M tokens, we'd need at least a 12-month commitment at ~1.4B tokens/year (approx 120M/month steady-state) — that maps to the tier in the attached pricing deck. For multi-year (24-mo) we can discuss an additional 7–10% incentive.

- Example quote we'll provide:
  a) Uncommitted hosted: $1,800 / 1M tokens
  b) 12-mo commit (1.4B tokens/year): $1,050 / 1M tokens before startup credit
  c) Apply startup credit (6 months) + 20% extra startup incentive we discussed privately => effective first-year blended ~$850 / 1M tokens (detailed math in the quote)

Marissa — I'll approve the 20% extra startup incentive for this account pending procurement sign-off and a standard MOU. Laura — can you draft the quote + sample MOU (12-mo, quarterly true-ups) and include SSO/KMS appendix?

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales — Enterprise
